verdict.rationale:
Baseten ships CLI-driven deployment (`truss push`, `baseten model push`) defined by a declarative config.yaml with no manual container/Dashboard steps, plus OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible REST endpoints and async webhook/polling inference — all scriptable for automation pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, GitHub Actions template, or documented headless auth/token flow for pipelines.
missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, documented non-interactive auth flow for pipelines.
